rules.name: Conversion Event Campaign
rules.description: If a valid conversion event contains a non-empty campaign ID, attribute to that campaign.

rules.name: Pre-Qualification Campaign Interaction
rules.description: If no conversion campaign exists, select the latest valid campaign interaction occurring before or at qualification.

rules.name: Source Precedence Tie-Break
rules.description: If competing campaign interactions have the exact same relevant timestamp, use configured source precedence.

rules.name: Lexicographic Campaign Tie-Break
rules.description: If all attribution evidence remains tied, select the lexicographically smallest campaign ID.
